clean_rebuild.source: git archive; no .git; empty CARGO_TARGET_DIR; locked dependencies

harness_corrections: Initial run verdict was FAIL and was not counted: the hand-written Outbox omitted hash_chain genesis/latest/height and added an unknown schema_version, so the baseline rejected JSON-01/02 as invalid_schema and TIME-01 was not verified. The fixture was corrected to canonical zero-height Outbox JSON and every case was rerun.
Report paths are unlinked before every invocation so a no-output assertion cannot inherit a stale report.

public_poll.scope: Point-in-time transport and internal consistency only; no publisher, remote Git, alliance, or ACK claim.

honest_corrections: Initial malformed-fixture differential FAIL is retained in the differential harness corrections and was rerun only after canonical genesis correction.
Rust toolchain restoration first timed out and left a missing manifest; stable was uninstalled/reinstalled before compilation. No security verdict was inferred.
Crate downloads initially stalled; locked dependencies were fetched from the configured mirror and subsequent builds ran offline. This changed infrastructure, not protocol rules.
not_proven: DNS resolution completely bounded by the HTTP client timeout or rebinding/pinning resistance
process-level memory, CPU, file-descriptor, or wall-clock isolation outside the CLI poll phase
distributed locking, non-cooperating writers, path aliases, CAS, WAL, whole-snapshot rollback resistance
publisher authentication, trusted time, QF-OS execution receipts, dead letters, QIOS compatibility
remote Git synchronization, alliance active, cisvr ACK, KEY-SYNC-01, or old PAT revocation
